artifact_policy: Template is unresolved. Register actual locally available immutable snapshots; no auto-download. Exact model variant must be verified before execution; new pins do not recover historical identity.

encoder.refits: Three actual fixed-data optimisation seeds; retain final epoch for the selected epoch budget.
encoder.selection: Final epoch validation macro-F1; ties within 1e-12 use smallest candidate_id. No test files read by search. Freeze winner before final refits.

failure_policy: Abort on hash/membership/audit mismatch. Do not silently change data, token caps, batch, search space or precision after failure; record a dated protocol amendment first.
hardware: Unresolved until GPU available. Record GPU/driver/CUDA/torch and pip freeze; choose a compatible GPU environment before executing. CPU checks do not certify CUDA compatibility.

latency.order: Per repetition use sha256(order_v1|repetition|record_id). Three repetitions within each fixed variant job; archive start/end GPU state. Separate model loads/jobs leave residual thermal/load drift; do not claim full randomised crossover control.
latency.selection: Per class choose smallest sha256(latency_v1|record_id); never use predictions. Same IDs for all variants and all three length conditions.
latency.summary: Per variant/condition: mean, median, p95, requests/s from measured end-to-end time, output lengths; paired record-level differences using per-record repetition means. This is serial batch-1 throughput, not service capacity.
latency.timing: Wall clock with CUDA synchronization before/after generate; end-to-end adds tokenization/H2D/decode/regex. Model/tokenizer loading, warmup, disk I/O excluded. Batch=1, no concurrent benchmark; unmerged adapter, same base precision.

long_input.evaluation: Same complete internal_test IDs; no retraining. 500/2048 is the token-cap control. Main comparison 500/2048 versus 1500/2048; separately report full narratives >500 chars. No legacy long text reconstruction.
long_input.length_audit: Record requested/retained narrative characters, pre-cap token count, retained tokens and prompt hash. No silent claim that all requested text was visible.
long_input.uncertainty: Observed macro-F1/weighted-F1/accuracy; 10000 paired label-blind group bootstrap with common multiplicities across conditions and repeats; seed/run SD separately. Reuse frozen internal groups.

membership: Use all frozen rows in original file order; no subsampling. Training shuffle may vary with optimisation seed.

qlora.selection: Best validation loss checkpoint within 2 epochs; fixed historical configuration, no new test-driven search.

serialization: Render the chat template once; tokenize with add_special_tokens=False. Pretokenized SFT input_ids/completion_mask use that same prefix, and full targets must fit 512 tokens. This explicit no-duplicate-BOS policy is for new runs, not an asserted historical reconstruction.
